# Crucible

> Crucible turns a 10-minute recording into a week of content: video shorts,
> carousel slides, deep dives, and multi-channel written posts — in your own
> voice. Record a raw brain dump or an AI-guided interview; Crucible handles
> the transcription, editing, and drafting.

## What Crucible is

- An end-to-end content system for founders, consultants, small business
  owners, and agencies — not just a clip cutter or a writing tool.
- An AI interviewer draws ideas out of unscripted thoughts; no finished
  video or blank-page writing required.
- Accepts multiple video clips from your phone and edits them together —
  stop and start recording whenever real work interrupts.
- Outputs: 60-second shorts, LinkedIn carousels, 5–10 minute deep dives,
  and written posts (LinkedIn, newsletters, blog) — all in your brand voice.
- Publishing: post straight to connected platforms (LinkedIn, X, and others
  that allow direct publishing); export files for everything else.
- Engagement analytics and brand growth monitoring are built in.
- Pricing: Starter $49/mo (4 complete campaigns), Pro $149/mo (16 campaigns
  + Social Research & Competitor Gap Engine), single credits $19. Every plan
  starts with a free credit for your first project.

## Key pages

- [How it works](https://trycrucible.com/how-it-works/): the four-step
  Crucible system — find inspiration, record raw thoughts, edit automated
  multi-channel results, publish and monitor growth.
- [Pricing](https://trycrucible.com/#pricing): Starter, Pro, Team & Agency
  (coming soon), and single-credit details.
- [Who Crucible is for](https://trycrucible.com/#who-its-for): founders,
  teams, and agencies.
- [For founders](https://trycrucible.com/for/founders/): founder-led content
  without a content team.
- [For consultants](https://trycrucible.com/for/consultants/): thought
  leadership that wins retainers.
- [For small business owners](https://trycrucible.com/for/smb-operators/):
  content captured in the gaps of the working day.
- [For agencies](https://trycrucible.com/for/agencies/): ghostwriters, PR
  agencies, and content shops scaling client output.
- [Comparisons](https://trycrucible.com/vs/): hub-and-spoke comparisons
  against social video apps, AI video generators, LinkedIn tools, and
  ghostwriting agencies (OpusClip, Descript, VEED, Captions, Submagic,
  Taja AI, Pressmaster, DraftAI, Vidgenie, StoryShort, Oiti AI, Supergrow,
  Avium, and more).
- [Blog](https://trycrucible.com/blog/): notes on founder-led content and
  the tools-vs-system philosophy.
